t: A small smart camera board you program in Python to see and recognize things.
steps: Buy the OpenMV N6 from the OpenMV store. The OpenMV Cam RT1062 is also sold by SparkFun and RobotShop.
Download and install the free OpenMV IDE on your computer.
Plug the camera into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Click the connect button in the IDE.
Open a basic example and press run to see the live camera feed.
Try a color tracking example and hold a bright object in front of the lens.
Solder the headers on later for robot and sensor projects.
meta: Open Board. From $140. A few stores.
